description.value: Road Runner Motel is a motel situated on Nicola Avenue in the Nicola Valley / Thompson region of British Columbia, a corridor used by touring cyclists travelling between the Interior and the Lower Mainland. As a roadside motel it offers basic overnight accommodation along this route. No further details about the property could be verified at this time.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL points to a Facebook page that returned a 'temporarily blocked' error, yielding no usable content; all amenity data must therefore rely solely on OSM tags. OSM confirms a motel at 2799 Nicola Avenue with internet_access=wlan, but per the rules OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration. No phone number or postal code is available in OSM or from the website, so contact fields are largely null.
